sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior branch, owner, typing, selector, location, and inclusive comparison repairs, but fix the remaining semantic errors. DIRECT_CALCULATION permits only the registered arithmetic and simple piecewise operations; replace every unsupported ABS call in both SPARQL constraints with an equivalent bounded piecewise/max construction for the expected-result-scaled tolerance, using the expected formula result rather than the reported value. Also scope the recommendedChestVolume calculation to the specific target ship whose hasComponent path selected the inlet chest; the current query can bind any ?ship that references $this and any unrelated ship power, causing cross-ship accidental passes. Use a ship-level calculation or an explicitly correlated owner path while retaining the declared ship-to-inletChest relationship and all operand/result checks.
